```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
library(ggplot2)

theme_tigit <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e6ebf0", linewidth = 0.35),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "#17202a", face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "#52616b"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0, color = "#17202a"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "#52616b", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 8)),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#17202a"),
      legend.text = element_text(color = "#52616b"),
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
    )
}

county <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/raw/poblacio-edat-tarragones-2021.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)
county <- county[county$CONCEPT == "POP" & county$SEX == "TOTAL" & !is.na(county$value), ]

county$age_years <- as.integer(ifelse(county$AGE == "Y_GE100", 100, substring(county$AGE, 2)))
county$group <- cut(
  county$age_years,
  breaks = c(0, 14, 64, Inf),
  right = TRUE,
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  labels = c("0-14 anys", "15-64 anys", "65+ anys")
)

totals <- aggregate(value ~ municipality_name, data = county, FUN = sum)
agg <- aggregate(value ~ municipality_name + group, data = county, FUN = sum)
agg <- merge(agg, totals, by = "municipality_name")
agg$pct <- 100 * agg$value.x / agg$value.y

ord <- agg[agg$group == "65+ anys", ]
ord <- ord[order(ord$pct), "municipality_name"]
agg$municipality_name <- factor(agg$municipality_name, levels = ord)
agg$group <- factor(agg$group, levels = c("0-14 anys", "15-64 anys", "65+ anys"))

fig <- ggplot(agg, aes(x = municipality_name, y = pct, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.72) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "0-14 anys" = "#c6dbef",
      "15-64 anys" = "#4292c6",
      "65+ anys" = "#2171b5"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Estructura d'edats dels municipis del Tarragonès per grans grups (2021)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentatge de la població",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Font: Idescat, cens de 2021."
  ) +
  theme_tigit()

output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/age-structure-tarragones-2021.svg")
dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(output, fig, width = 9, height = 6.5, device = svglite::svglite)
```
